note: Single-loop CCC-era campground on a wooded peninsula in 638-acre Lake Jeanette, off the Echo Trail. Back-in gravel spurs under shade. --Claude
summary: rec.gov/RIDB re-read: 12 sites (9 RV drive-in at 35 ft max, 6 of them reservable 05-10; 01-03 FCFS; one 20-ft tent site; two hike-in tent), $18 in 2026, $9 extra vehicle, 9 people, 14-night limit, vault toilets + peak-season water. Outside the post-wildfire closure area (Exhibit B shows 'The Echo Trail is Open' and no closed campground at Lake Jeanette). Not waterfront kept, lakeview candidate flagged. Season (manual 05-08..09-26) left alone.
flags: STATUS open: Superior NF post-wildfire closure order 09-09-00-26-11 (effective 2026-10-01) Exhibit B West Zone map shows the closure polygon north of the Echo Trail starting at entry points 14/15, with 'The Echo Trail is Open'; Lake Jeanette (west of entry point 14, south of the polygon) carries no closed-campground symbol. No change.

WATERFRONT contrary claim (gate run): rec.gov lists the amenity 'Waterfront Sites' and says 'Most sites have a view of the lake and some are located on the lakeshore.' The RIDB catalog flags no site for proximity to water and marks every site 'Shade: Yes'. On Esri imagery the peninsula is under continuous mixed canopy; the RV site points (05 48.13212,-92.29636; 06 48.13213,-92.29656; 07 48.13200,-92.29676) lie roughly 40-50 m from the rocky north and west shores through trees, with no open apron. Not waterfront kept by the canopy rule; LAKEVIEW is a candidate on the operator's 'most sites have a view of the lake' (sites 05-07 at the peninsula tip are the likeliest). Reviewer's call.

NOTE correction: the old note said 'pull-in sites for moderate-size vehicles'; the catalog has back-in spurs (site 08 parallel), 35 ft max. Also 3 (not 4) FCFS standard sites in the catalog (01-03); rec.gov's prose says 4.
Pin 48.13200,-92.29650 is on the loop beside sites 05-07 (rec.gov facility point 48.13222,-92.29583, ~55 m NE). No move.
PHONE: none stored; rec.gov lists (218) 666-0020 (LaCroix Ranger District, Cook).
